title: Transform PumpStation into a simulation-first community capital institution
problem: The repository encodes memecoin coordination and automated exits, while the clarified founder intent requires lawful productive ownership, organized agents, zero-trust controls, and staged public operation.
baseline: A static wallet demo with an unsafe market-coordination doctrine and no real tests.

alternatives.name: Do nothing
alternatives.description: Leave or archive the existing demo.

alternatives.name: Education portal
alternatives.description: Build only community education and research.

alternatives.name: Conventional investment-club software
alternatives.description: Use a standard human-run platform without agent orchestration.

alternatives.name: Simulation-first institution
alternatives.description: Build evidence-bound opportunity review and staged authority with no external effects.

do_nothing_option.name: Do nothing
do_nothing_option.description: Archive the repository and make no active product claim.
do_nothing_option.tradeoffs: Avoids immediate risk and cost but abandons the opportunity to build productive community-capital infrastructure.
do_nothing_option.revival_evidence: Revive if the founder chooses to reopen the project or the simulation experiment becomes unjustified.

roles.name: Founder-Intent Steward
roles.analysis: Retain collective wealth creation, productive ownership, agent collaboration, and eventual public operation while prohibiting the harmful mechanism.

roles.name: Systems Architect
roles.analysis: PumpStation should own domain workflows but consume identity, authority, and consequence contracts from UNIIMENTE Kernel.

roles.name: Adversarial Reviewer
roles.analysis: The principal risks are manipulation reintroduction, fake evidence, self-approval, regulatory overclaim, and governance theater.

roles.name: Operator and Maintainer
roles.analysis: Begin with a small event-sourced Node runtime, clear stage ladder, tests, and observable refusal behavior.

roles.name: Evidence and Welfare Guardian
roles.analysis: Require conflicts, proposer holdings, bear thesis, participant harms, admissible evidence, dissent, and affinity-fraud protections.

evidence.claim: The original repository explicitly described memecoin coordination and automated exits.
The local sandbox implementation passed deterministic unit and negative tests.
The collaboration Skill validators accepted the intent and deliberation records.

counterevidence.claim: No real user, legal vehicle, capital deployment, external effect, independently verified outcome, or commercial result exists.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Create a powerful but bounded community capital institution whose value comes from productive assets and verified outcomes.

advantages.amplification: Preserve attributable evidence, dissent, calibration, and reusable decision history.
Use independent roles and benchmark them against one agent, rules, and human review.
Direct it toward operating cash flow, acquisitions, infrastructure, and business building.
Reserve it for proof, identity, escrow, governance, and settlement where multiple parties need a common record.

disadvantages.description: Group coordination can become market manipulation.
disadvantages.redesign: Hard refusal rules and productive-asset focus.

disadvantages.description: Immigrant identity can be exploited as affinity pressure.
disadvantages.redesign: Disclosures, protected dissent, cooling-off, complaints, and no loyalty-based recruitment.

disadvantages.description: Agent agreement can manufacture false confidence.
disadvantages.redesign: Evidence tiers, bear thesis, five roles, and no authority from consensus.

disadvantages.description: A fund framing can outrun legal authority.
disadvantages.redesign: Simulation-first ladder and external legal prerequisites.

disadvantages.description: Governance can become slow and ceremonial.
disadvantages.redesign: Consequence-tiered review and benchmark founder/operator burden.

disadvantages.description: Blockchain can create cost, privacy, and complexity.
disadvantages.redesign: Use off-chain operations and selective on-chain anchors only.

pass_2.attack: The strengthened design can still become overengineered, centralized around the founder, vulnerable to role spoofing, gamed by polished evidence packets, and disconnected from real productive outcomes.
new_weaknesses: Development header roles are not authentication.
Append-only JSON is not production concurrency control.
A large governance surface can become theater.
No real external evidence or economics exist.

disadvantage_dispositions.action: Prohibit coordinated market conduct in policy and negative tests.
Add participant-rights workflow before closed pilot and measure complaints and dissent suppression.
Run preregistered multi-agent versus simpler-baseline benchmark.
Keep all capital stages blocked pending founder and qualified legal decisions.
Track founder and operator minutes per valid decision; simplify if complexity does not earn its cost.
Do not implement blockchain until a shared-trust transaction proves the need.

pass_2.strengthened_design: A simulation-only, event-sourced community capital laboratory with typed opportunities, five-role deliberation, two-pass strengthening, founder hash authorization, admissible evidence, staged launch, and no external execution.
residual_risks: No production identity or Kernel contract integration.
No external buyer, capital, or verified outcome.

dissent.position: Prefer an education cooperative without capital workflows.
dissent.evidence_threshold: PumpStation must outperform education-only and conventional workflows without unacceptable burden.

dissent.position: Delay public repository transformation until Kernel contracts are integrated.
dissent.rationale: Avoid local authority semantics becoming canonical.
dissent.evidence_threshold: Current phase must remain visibly sandbox-only and nonexecuting.

authority_impact: No new real-world authority. The founder may authorize simulations only. Production consequences remain reserved to UNIIMENTE Kernel and accountable humans.
migration_plan: Preserve Git history and wallet identity concept; replace active doctrine; add governance records, sandbox runtime, tests, and a draft PR; integrate Kernel contracts in a later PR.
rollback_plan: Close the draft PR or revert its commits. Main remains unchanged until authorized merge.
kill_criteria: Any path moves money or places trades in sandbox.
Manipulation or affinity pressure becomes an accepted feature.
The system claims commercial proof from fixtures.
Complexity fails to beat simpler alternatives after benchmark.
review_trigger: After CI, security review, Kernel integration design, and the preregistered benchmark.
